matches.quote: The observation is also what one expects from ordinary minor-loop hysteresis and kinetic arrest of a first-order transition
The dwell time at T_T, the time for the spot to reach T_T and to cool back, the acquisition time per spectrum... are not given
The target-temperature scale T_T, the x-axis of the central result, is partly circular and its uncertainty is underestimated.
repeat the Raman T_T sequence on a fresh spot using the cold-finger/cryostat heater for the excursion, with read-out at T_B at fixed low power
The Introduction on ultrafast optical control (coherent phonon driving and similar) is not relevant to a quasi-static laser-heating experiment and may mislead readers about the mechanism.
The local Raman effect could also have a non-thermal part... this would establish whether the effect is thermal and whether the laser adds anything
Non-volatility, the defining property of the claimed resistive switching, is not tested. Retention of the high-resistance state at T_B over time is not measured
calibrate the JT intensity against an independent phase-fraction estimate... Either link it to a measured quantity (for example an FMM fraction estimated from M) or label it as a schematic
A spurious peak near 660–670 cm⁻¹ (red dashed line, Fig. 2a) is attributed to "local oxygen vacancies" without evidence... and it grows strongly near 180–210 K in Fig. 2b.
The resistivity is two-probe on a polycrystalline pellet... so contact and grain-boundary resistance... are included... The authors should repeat the key ρ data with four-probe contacts
Figs. S4/S5 use T_FPS and T_OCO while the main text uses T_C and T_COO; T_IM and T_MI are used inconsistently
Please state the grids actually used and the T_T values of the Raman cycles in Fig. 3. The Methods should also give the waiting time at T_B
the Methods say the cyclic procedure is in "figure 1 a" (it is 1b)

notes: C16 and P18 both flag the same erroneous 'figure 1 a' reference in the Methods sentence on magnetization and resistance cycling (the referee read 'depicted in figure 1 a' as referring to the M/R data in Fig. 4, while the review read it as referring to the cycling protocol in Fig. 1b). For C3, v1 includes a power-to-temperature table in the Supplementary Materials, but the main text omits the method and the review critiques the validity and underestimated uncertainty of that calibration.
